data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘as-sawar’, meaning a small seed. The name Asyirah symbolizes growth and rebirth, reflecting the idea that even the smallest of seeds holds immense potential. This name is often given to babies born during the spring season, when new life is beginning to sprout and blossom. The name Asyirah carries the meaning “Small seed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asyirah usually hope their child will grow to embody small seed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
